name: LayerFS for Herdr
summary: Each Herdr workspace is a LayerFS Branch: a new one in ~0.2 s, restored after restart.

versions.notes: A failed fork or reopen now stops the Sandbox daemon that attempt created, through SDK sandbox.close, once its mounts are cleaned up; reused or shared daemons keep running.

A failed fork is kept as a closed Branch with its error (reopen or drop to recover); reopen can adopt an existing Store Branch without a plugin record; fork from an agent pane outside the repo opens the Branch under the source repo.
drop [name] now cleans up closed Branches directly (no remount); optional --delete-git-branch deletes the Git branch only when merged. Store data is kept, so drop does not reclaim space.
Adds Branch merge (reports real conflicts, ignores each Branch's root .git link), keeps state until drop cleanup succeeds, and resolves the current Branch from cwd outside Herdr.
First listing: docker mode on LayerFS main verified end to end on Debian 13; agents fork from their own pane.
